verdict.rationale: First-party docs say LlamaCloud, including LlamaParse and LlamaExtract, can be deployed entirely within your own infrastructure. This runs on Kubernetes via Helm charts on AWS, Azure, or GCP, and the enterprise-readiness page lists self-hosting and BYOC among the deployment options. Community remarks about 'wrapper around a paid hosted service' are general skepticism, not a concrete contradiction of the self-hosting docs. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of a self-hosted deployment, clarity on licensing or plan gating (e.g. enterprise-only access), details on fully local or air-gapped model operation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: LlamaCloud can be deployed entirely within your own infrastructure.
Run LlamaParse, LlamaExtract, and the complete LlamaCloud platform on Kubernetes using Helm charts — on AWS, Azure, or GCP.
managed SaaS, single-tenant, BYOC, self-hosting, and regional endpoints
